_comment: Dated turning points of the era. kind: war | peace | pardon | pardon_end. sides: two lists of factions. Events in milestone 7 can add branches; these are the fixed anchors.

beyond_the_line.text: No peace beyond the line: French governors still commission buccaneers against Spain.

truce_of_ratisbon.text: The Truce of Ratisbon: France and Spain lay down their arms. French commissions against Spain are void.

nine_years_war.text: The Nine Years' War: England, the Dutch Republic and Spain against France. Letters of marque are easy to come by.

peace_of_ryswick.text: The Peace of Ryswick ends the Nine Years' War. Privateers are out of work.

spanish_succession.text: The War of the Spanish Succession: England and the Dutch against France and Spain.

treaty_of_utrecht.text: The Treaty of Utrecht. Thousands of privateers are paid off; many will turn pirate.

kings_pardon.text: The King's Pardon: any pirate who surrenders to an English governor within the year will be forgiven.

kings_pardon_ends.text: The King's Pardon expires. Woodes Rogers' Nassau has no more mercy to give.

quadruple_alliance.text: The War of the Quadruple Alliance: England, France and the Dutch against Spain.

treaty_of_the_hague.text: The Treaty of The Hague ends the war with Spain.
